verdict.rationale: Riveter is a web scraping and enrichment API, so per-URL-pattern crawl configuration is a fair axis for it. The evidence shows single-URL scrapes and batch enrichments of up to 10,000 rows. Nothing documents assigning different crawl or scrape settings to different URL patterns within one batch job.

support.subject: As a developer, I can apply different crawl configurations to different URL patterns within a single batch job
